Leicester is a thriving area with strong demand for reliable new boiler supply and installation services. Local properties range from period Victorian and Edwardian homes through to modern new-build developments, each presenting different plumbing requirements and challenges.

Our Gas Safe registered engineers serve all areas of Leicester and the surrounding Leicestershire region. Whether you're in the town centre or the surrounding residential areas, we provide prompt, professional boiler installation services with transparent pricing and no hidden call-out charges.

With years of experience working across Leicestershire, our engineers understand the specific plumbing challenges faced by local homeowners. From the older pipe infrastructure common in period properties to the modern systems found in newer developments, our team has the expertise to handle any new boiler supply and installation requirement.

We cover all postcodes across Leicester with same-day availability for urgent work. All our engineers are fully qualified, insured, and committed to leaving your property clean and tidy after every job.

faqs.q: How long does a boiler installation take?
faqs.a: A straightforward like-for-like combi boiler swap takes 1-2 days. Moving the boiler location or converting from a heat-only system to a combi takes 2-4 days.

faqs.q: Do I need a combi boiler or a system boiler?
faqs.a: Combi boilers suit most homes up to 3 bedrooms with 1-2 bathrooms — no hot water tank needed. System boilers suit larger homes with higher hot water demand. Your installer should calculate your requirements before recommending.

faqs.q: What is the best boiler brand?
faqs.a: Worcester Bosch, Viessmann, and Vaillant consistently top reliability surveys. All three offer extended warranties of 8-12 years when installed by accredited engineers. Brand matters less than correct sizing and installation quality.

faqs.q: Do I need to notify anyone when a new boiler is installed?
faqs.a: Yes — your Gas Safe registered installer must notify Building Control within 30 days of installation under the Competent Person Scheme. You will receive a Building Regulations completion certificate.

localParagraph: Leicester presents a genuinely varied landscape for boiler installation engineers, with the city's mixed housing stock ranging from Victorian terraced properties in areas like Clarendon Park and Highfields through to post-war semis in Oadby and newer developments around Birstall and Glenfield. This diversity of property ages and construction types means that boiler installations across Leicester rarely follow a one-size-fits-all approach, as older homes may require updated pipework or flue configurations to meet current regulations. The city also sits within an area of mixed water hardness, where conditions can lean harder in some districts and softer in others, making it worthwhile for homeowners to discuss scale inhibitor or water treatment options with their installer to protect the longevity of a new system. Across England, manufacturers increasingly recommend such precautions in mixed hardness zones. Choosing a Gas Safe registered engineer familiar with Leicester's particular blend of property types and local water characteristics will help ensure that your new boiler is sized, positioned, and commissioned correctly for years of reliable performance.
whatItInvolves: A new boiler installation involves removing your existing unit, upgrading the flue and pipework where required, fitting and commissioning the new boiler, and registering it with Building Control via the Competent Person Scheme. All new boiler installations must be carried out by a Gas Safe registered engineer — it is illegal for anyone else to do this work.
process: Day 1: drain down the system, remove the old boiler, cap off existing connections. Upgrade the flue if required — most modern boilers use a concentric flue that vents through an external wall. Fit the new unit, connect flow and return pipes, gas supply, and condensate drain. Commission the boiler following manufacturer guidelines, balance the radiators, and register the installation. You'll receive a Building Regulations completion certificate within 28 days.
whatToExpect: A standard like-for-like boiler swap takes 1-2 days. A full system change — moving the boiler or converting from back boiler to combi — takes 2-4 days. Your new boiler should come with a manufacturer warranty of 5-12 years depending on brand. Always register the warranty within 30 days of installation.
